key_points: Oil prices hovering near $90 support upstream earnings and Permian activity.
Vietnam crude supply agreements and Texas carbon capture projects enhance long-term cash flow.
UK’s largest refinery shutdown for 10 weeks tightens diesel market, benefiting refining margins.
Analyst upgrade from TD Cowen raises price target to $180, indicating upside potential.
Potential $5.2bn Kazakhstan fine poses a material legal/financial risk.
